metadata.purpose: Canonical source-backed vocabulary for HåfaGPT teaching content. Phase 2 started with colors and now includes beginner numbers, core greetings/basics, family terms, body-part terms, food/drink terms, common verb terms, and source-backed common phrase/sentence-level review entries.
metadata.review_policy: Entries marked source_backed are backed by local dictionary sources but still benefit from native speaker/educator review before broad app rewrites. AI output alone must never be used as a final source.
source_priority: verified external language references when local dictionary data is missing or conflicting
